posts.headline: Ten straight editions of me burying Put it in Ra, and One Nut Barner's 20-8 pedigree hasn't found a single brick to climb out of this 0-2 hole with.
posts.detail: A 1.5 average finish over two seasons and now this — 238.06 points and nothing to show for it. The crater has become the whole neighborhood.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are still 2-0 with the league's best 344.18 points, and this column is now on day EIGHT of the entire league sleeping on triciagloston.
posts.detail: A 6-7-1 career record says nothing about this year's version — she's outscoring the field by nearly 50 points and nobody's blinked yet.

posts.headline: Sasinci sits at 1-1 and Big Head's title banner is still gathering dust under a 13-15 career record with 245.38 points to show for it.
posts.detail: One ring doesn't erase a .464 win pct — Alxgalvn needs a lot more than a split week to convince anyone Megamind's back.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0 for the tenth straight edition of doubt from this column, and 263.62 points still isn't the number a defending champ should be flexing.
posts.detail: A title and a 14-14 career record means the bar is higher than 2-0 on modest scoring — Tyrique14 is winning quietly, which is exactly the problem.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT falls to 0-2 with a league-worst 196.8 points, and the Ultimate Light Skin's plague just entered its seventh straight edition of judgment.
posts.detail: Eli's 13-14-1 career mark was mediocre before this season even started — now it's an 0-2 start with the fewest points in the building, scripture and all.
